title: MarkSafe field schema
description: The properties a form may use: field names with a dot. The same format is used in a schema file and in the document's front matter under `schema:`. A schema file needs an `id`; a schema written in a document does not. Beyond this file, no property may be a level of another (`a.b` next to `a.b.c`), and every `legacy` target must be a property.

id.description: Identifier ending in a version. It is never fetched. A published schema only grows; what breaks gets a new version.

legacy.description: Old names without a dot and the property replacing them. They stay valid, since released documents are signed.

requires.description: When a value exists. The words belong to the schema's owner.

example.description: A made-up value per language for a preview, never real data. A date is written as the field shows it, e.g. 16.10.2026.

fixed.description: The person filling in the form cannot change the value.

right.description: What the filling tool requires for a value.
